title: From Seasonal Labour to Self-Reliance
subtitle: Lucknow’s Santosh Kumar’s Journey through the NSFDC Term Loan Scheme
body_text:
The National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC), through its Term Loan Scheme, provides financial assistance to eligible beneficiaries to pursue income-generating activities and work towards economic self-reliance.
For many families dependent on seasonal agricultural work, limited income and a lack of financial resources can make it difficult to establish a stable livelihood.
The journey of Shri Santosh Kumar from Gosainganj Block in Lucknow district of Uttar Pradesh illustrates how such assistance can create opportunities for sustainable self-employment.
Shri Santosh Kumar, 36, and his family previously depended on seasonal agricultural work for their livelihood. With an annual family income of only ₹70,000 to ₹80,000, meeting daily household expenses was challenging. Although he possessed driving skills, financial constraints prevented him from purchasing a vehicle and starting his own self-employment venture.
A significant change came when Shri Santosh Kumar received financial assistance of ₹3 lakh under the NSFDC Term Loan Scheme. With this support, he purchased an auto-rickshaw and started his own business. The assistance enabled him to utilise his driving skills productively and establish a source of regular income, reducing his dependence on seasonal agricultural employment.
Today, Shri Santosh Kumar is successfully operating his auto-rickshaw, and his family’s annual income has increased to approximately ₹2.25 lakh, compared with its earlier earnings of ₹70,000 to ₹80,000. This improvement has strengthened the family’s financial position and contributed to a better standard of living. His journey reflects the positive impact of access to financial assistance in enabling individuals to overcome economic constraints and build a more secure future.
Shri Santosh Kumar’s experience highlights how the NSFDC Term Loan Scheme can support self-employment, promote livelihood opportunities and empower beneficiaries to move towards economic independence. By transforming his driving skills into a sustainable source of income, he has taken a significant step towards self-reliance and a more dignified life for his family.
